text1: The Hyacinth is the pride of Iskalan engineering, being capable enough to take on much larger capital ships, whilist still being an agile and nimble vessel able to take on numerous smaller vessels.

The Union of Iskala is a constitutional monarchy, whose monarch acts as the head of state, leading its senate and running most internal affairs.  While the heir next in line for the throne acts as the leader of part of Iskala’s military and has significant sway over foreign affairs.  

The Union of Iskala, formed on the planet of Iskala, was originally a “terraforming effort” organized by the auspicious Tartarus sector Overseer {}; and enacted by domain military personnel, the Eridani corporation, and the Sacha Corporation.  With the terraforming effort partly finished when the collapse struck the courageous explorers arrived and “infighting” occurred as to the course of actions the colonists would take.  This resulted in the isolation of Iskala and fracturing of the colonists into multiple factions.  Though kept in check by the united terraforming efforts, with the final transformation of Iskala from a ball of ice into a mostly terran world, war broke out on the planet for nearly the next century.  
This period of Iska?an history “ended” with multiple large Nations and numerous City-States sharing fragile peace on Iskala, though the largest among them was the królestwo dwunastu gwiazd (Kingdom of Twelve stars) ruled by the Vasilensko family.  The Vasilensko family was home to multiple of the greatest military geniuses of Iskalan history, and had recently merged with the Sacha family, who were renowned for their innovations in numerous technologies.  

This peace was broken by the Hegemony, who arrived in force to “reclaim the system for the restoration of the Dominion of man”, however few on Iskala cared for the Hegemony’s poor propaganda.  This blatant invasion united most Iskalans behind a single cause under the leadership of the Vasilensko family, leading to the creation of the Union of Iskala, and the arrival of the Union of Iskala to the sector.  Since this tumultuous arrival, the Iskalans have shown themselves to be skilled in terraforming, leagues ahead of anyone in the sector.  This led to the rapid colonization of nearby systems and the cementing of Iskala as a formidable power.

ACCORDING TO UNION OF ISKALA MEDIA: Once an ice planet, Lazurowe Morze has been terraformed into a water world with a comfortable gravity for human habitation.  Though not as favorable for human habitation as Ladnysiez, it sports a sizable population, good tourism, and large cities. Its economy is boosted by its mineral and water exports to Kuznia.  Where the water supports the population and terraforming efforts on the planet.

ACCORDING TO UNION OF ISKALA MEDIA: Kuznia is a Desert world with next to no atmosphere, determined to not even be a worthwhile terraforming project.  This however, combined with how close it is to the Swiatana system made it a perfect choice to set up heavy industry reliant on dirty Domain era nanoforges and industrial techniques.  Known to produce reliable ships within some of the safest conditions within the sector, Kuznia is home to the largest concentration of immigrants within the Union of Iskala.
text3: Approaching Kuznia, the local military orbital coordinator hails you and directs you to the orbit your fleet will hold.  As you orbit, you look at the planet below.  Large wind-swept deserts cover the planet; dotted with the occasional oasis, and red plants stradling said oasis.  The largest features on the surface are the massive industrial cities built into the mountains, with massive hangers housing countless freighters hauling materials from the surface up to the enormous orbital shipyards your fleet dances around in orbit. Though the oasis you saw hints at the planet's hopes of becoming habitable one day, and the distinct lack of industrial pollution supports the idea that those goals may one day come true.  The massive industrial parks are quite telling as to the current purpose of the planet.  You eventually decide to travel down to the surface.

text1: ACCORDING TO ACADEMIAN LAYLA HYPERION: Iskala was colonized shortly after the collapse of the gate network,and was mired with issues. The gate network was never built within the system, and the terraforming efforts made before the arrival of the colonists failed halfway through.  However Iskala was habitable, and the colonists spent blood sweat and tears to transform the planet into a world that rivals even Gilead.
text3: As you approach Iskala, an Iskalan military officer hails you, and after giving you a stern look, orders you to enter the designated orbital lane for incoming vessels.  As you orbit, you look at the surface and the beauty of the planet below.  Rivers lazily meander across the surface, while large polar ice caps cover a large chunk of the planet.  Across the planet, forests of deep green trees cover the surface of the planet.  Though you note large spots of red, seemingly plant life, but of a dark red color forming the boundary between areas of greenery and black earth.  large lakes, with not enough salt to be considered oceans, form at the equator of the planet.  Eventually you decide to land on the planet.

text1: ACCORDING TO HISTORIAN JANUS KUBERSKI: The first planet to be settled within the Swiatana system, outside of Iskala, and the home of the Iskala terraforming bureau. This planet is the pride and joy of Iskalan Terraforming Bureau, which transformed the planet at the behest of the newly formed Union of Iskala.  Transforming it from a rocky ball into a verdant archipelago world housing numerous resorts, farms, and cities.
